diagram:
flowchart TD
  SCHED["⏰ Weekday 4:15 PM (post-close)"] --> OPEN["📋 Fetch open paper_positions"]
  OPEN --> PRICE["💲 Current prices (Massive)"]
  PRICE --> TRAIL["📈 Trailing stop\nrises with highest_price, never falls"]
  PRICE --> TARGET{"Target or stop hit?"}
  PRICE --> FLAG{"exit_reason = llm_exit?"}
  TARGET -->|"Yes"| CLOSE["✅ Close position + write outcome"]
  FLAG -->|"Yes"| CLOSE
  TARGET -->|"No"| HOLD["⏳ Hold"]

SCHED.label: Weekday 4:15 PM
SCHED.description: Runs after market close. Deterministic — a Flow, not an LLM.
SCHED.addReason: Post-close is when the day's exits are evaluated.

OPEN.label: Fetch open positions
OPEN.description: Loads all open paper_positions to evaluate for exit.
OPEN.addReason: Only open positions can be exited.

PRICE.label: Current prices
PRICE.description: Batch-fetches current prices via the Massive API (Polygon fallback).

TRAIL.label: Trailing stop
TRAIL.description: Trailing-stop logic: the stop rises with highest_price but never falls below the original stop — locks in gains without cutting winners early.
TRAIL.addReason: Let winners run while protecting profit.

TARGET.label: Target or stop hit?
TARGET.description: Closes if price target reached or stop breached.

FLAG.label: llm_exit flag?
FLAG.description: Honors exit_reason='llm_exit' set by the LearnerAgent when a thesis breaks mid-trade — the monitor does the actual close (clean separation of concerns).
FLAG.addReason: Learner flags; monitor executes the close.

CLOSE.label: Close + write outcome
CLOSE.description: Closes the position, records realized P&L and outcome — which becomes the LearnerAgent's ground truth.

HOLD.label: Hold
HOLD.description: No exit condition met — position carries to the next session.
